decision_options.recommended: Approve metadata-only bounded probes with local-only cache, explicit attribution, source/version pins, and no term redistribution or promotion.
decision_options.contingency: If licence, authority, or component scope is unclear, remain documentation-only/no-go and seek maintainer or rights-holder clarification.
decision_options.formal_review: Use legal or institutional review before any redistribution, derived artefact, publication, or downstream promotion.

source_specific_recommendations.PATO: BSD-3-Clause repository attribution; verify release components.
source_specific_recommendations.MP: CC BY 4.0 candidate; require release-specific MGI confirmation and version/date attribution.
source_specific_recommendations.uPheno: Require component authority/licence matrix; do not infer aggregate licence.
source_specific_recommendations.FMA: Keep documentation-only until SIG confirms exact licence and current release.
source_specific_recommendations.LOINC: Account/licence acceptance scoped to local-only metadata; seek Regenstrief clarification if terms are unclear.
source_specific_recommendations.MeSH: Bounded metadata under NLM attribution/freshness terms; no redistribution until scope confirmed.
source_specific_recommendations.Orphanet: Approve only Orphadata Science CC BY 4.0 product; exclude DTA/pricing products.
